facts.value: The largest of the predominantly Black Pentecostal churches. In 1907 Mason took most of the body into Pentecostalism, and those who remained formed the Church of Christ (Holiness) U.S.A.

citations.excerpt: The Church of God in Christ, the largest of the several predominantly black Pentecostal churches
In 1907, Mason took most of the body into Pentecostalism. Those who remained were organized by Elder Charles Prince Jones as the Church of Christ (Holiness) U.S.A.
